brief: 5 Deep Focus rituals to ship more in fewer hours.

slots.title: The Context Tax
slots.body: Every interruption steals twenty minutes of refocus time. Protect your attention like a limited budget.

slots.title: Time Block Deep Work
slots.body: Schedule focused sessions as calendar events with hard start and end times. Treat them like client meetings.

slots.title: Phone Goes Far Away
slots.body: Place your device in another room during focus blocks. Physical distance outperforms willpower every single time.

slots.title: One Tab Only Rule
slots.body: Commit to a single browser tab or document. Multitasking is a myth that destroys quality and speed.

slots.title: Set A Hard Timer
slots.body: Use a visible countdown to create urgency. Work shrinks to fit the container you give it.

slots.title: Daily Shutdown Ritual
slots.body: Spend five minutes reviewing wins and writing tomorrow's priority. Close the laptop with a clear mind.
Pick one ritual and test it tomorrow. Small focus wins compound into massive weekly output.
